name: Chris Gauthier
bio: Christopher Gauthier (January 27, 1976 - February 23, 2024) was an English-born Canadian actor. He was married with two children and resided in Vancouver, British Columbia, Canada. Chris had a recurring role on the SyFy Channel series Eureka, as Café Diem owner Vincent. While filming the final 10 episodes of season three of Eureka, Chris also filmed the 2009 CBS Mystery Event Harper's Island in which he appears as Malcolm Ross, and in Freddy vs. Jason as Shack.
